maintenance_led.reason: Sells consumable candy (Tootsie Roll, Tootsie Pop, Dots, Junior Mints) used up by consumers, not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Candy sold through supermarkets, drug, dollar and convenience stores to consumers; paid by private buyers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own candy brands from its own plants; only occasional brand acquisitions like Dots, Charms.

mission_critical.reason: Retailers and consumers can easily switch to other candy brands; confectionery is discretionary and substitutable.
